column1: # One row per family. Tab-separated, three columns:
#   1. Family directory under fonts/, and the name Typst matches on.
#   2. Directory under github.com/google/fonts, which also holds OFL.txt.
#   3. Semicolon-separated file names to fetch from that directory.
#      Semicolon, not comma: variable font names carry commas between axes,
# Variable fonts carry their whole weight axis in one file, so they need one
# entry. Typst 0.15 reads the axis and honours `weight:` across its full range.
# Static families list only the weights a template names. No italics: no
# tools/fetch-fonts.sh reads this file. Every family here is under the SIL Open
# Font License 1.1. The licence text travels with the files in fonts/LICENCES/.
